messages.author: 08f3062efe0fd1ca
messages.subject: Re: changing tick label
parts:
This is how I did it to plot the graph I presented at our first anonymous Rcoholics meeting last month for your colleague next door. The breaks are POSIX time elements, FWIW. I have colored the relevant line

bplot2 <- bplot +
        geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="white", colour="black")+
        scale_x_discrete(breaks=c("07:00", "08:00", "09:00", "10:00", "11:00", "12:00", "13:00", "14:00", "15:00", "16:00", "17:00", "18:00", "19:00", "20:00")) +
        facet_wrap(~Datum, ncol=6, scales="fixed") +
        custom.theme()
ggsave("cebDat.png")

Cheers,
Roman

well, if it is actually the labels that you want to change rather than
